item.title: Drivers now face £80 fines for 'long goodbyes' at Heathrow Airport in major eco-push
item.description: Heathrow Airport will start fining drivers £80 if they spend too long saying their goodbyes at drop-off zones under new plans aimed at pushing more travellers onto public transport.From January, the drop-off charge will jump from £6 to £7 - with the maximum amount of time allowed in the zone capped to just 10 minutes. item.title: Man slapped with £100 fine for calling his neighbour fat
item.description: A man has been slapped with a £100 fine after calling his neighbour "fat".
